[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts
 Section: 22::Three years.
]


For money deposited under an agreement that it shall be payable on demand, including money of a customer in the hands of his banker so payable.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the demand is made.
